goal: VC-201-060 (P1) claims mastery of: Round-trip supported model endpoints, runtime requirements, secret references, and placement policies between local and supported cloud targets; compatibility checks surface nonportable settings before any changes.. Its own narrative does not claim delivery: PARTIAL: Kubernetes model-serving targets are catalogued as validated profiles with canonical capabilities and facts. Verified by `crates/susi-vendor-models/src/eco_k8s_serving.rs`: profile_is_valid, capabilities_are_canonical, facts_cover_the_required_surface, store_stays_consistent. Residual: the mastery target's export/restore round-trip of endpoints, runtime requirements, secret references and. Prove or refute it: add a nonzero test named vc_201_060_mastery_* that exercises the capability on its production path, and record exactly which part is missing when it cannot be proven. Coverage is not mastery: this closes only when the capability is verified, and a linked closed task is not evidence. Closing this task records the outcome, not a passing test: write .agents/roadmap-verdicts/<the vector>.json with verdict 'delivered' (and the test or record that proves it) or 'not-delivered' (with what is missing and the task ids that track the follow-up work), then run scripts/check-roadmap-verdict.py <the vector> — which is this task's acceptance. A refutation therefore closes the task and files the work, instead of stalling on a test that cannot pass; the roadmap and the queue both understand the record.
